calls.reason: Evidence is mixed. Huang et al. found limits on unaided self-correction in older models, while SCoRe and the OEL framework show trained self-correction and learning from deployment experience. None compares deployed systems with humans.
This open-ended forecast has no deadline and no defined group of boosters. The only evidence is Altman's admission of error before the post, and nothing documents later denials.
This is an indefinite negative forecast. The AGI Society review finds AGI claims unproven but contested, and the Digital Consciousness Model calls the evidence against LLM consciousness not decisive.
The claim depends on a bubble bursting, which has not happened. OpenAI's 11-day pause ended with training resumed, and DeepSeek's distillation predates the claim.
The claim depends on OpenAI and Anthropic collapsing, which has not happened. Anthropic filed for an IPO in October 2026, and the four-year window runs to 2030.
